As part of the Care Management services, a Care Team is ready to support you. The Care Team
is made up of your main doctor, any other person (of your choice) involved in your care, and
your Care Manager. If you decide to participate in the Care Management program, you can
speak with your Care Team about your care needs any time during our normal business hours.

If you are not in the Care Management program, you can still call if you would like to:
e Learn more about L.A. Care's Care Management program
e Get help completing your Health Risk Assessment (if not already completed)
e Review your Health Risk Assessment results with a Care Manager

The Care Management Department can be reached at 1-844-200-0104 and is available Monday
through Friday from 8:00am - 5:00pm (excluding some holidays).

Sincerely,

Joyce, LCSW
Care Management Department
L.A. Care Health Plan

Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) Office of the Ombudsman

For help with Medi-Cal, you may call the California Department of Health Care Services
(DHCS) Ombudsman Office at 1-888-452-8609, Monday through Friday, 8:00 am — 5:00 pm
(excluding holidays). The Ombudsman Office helps people with Medi-Cal make use of their
rights and responsibilities.
